MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The prototype boards feel like a natural next step from my breadboards and circuit parts because they would let me turn temporary circuits into soldered projects.",
    "The test leads and component tester support the same hands-on work: connecting small parts, checking them before assembly, and troubleshooting circuits."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Fast color-changing LEDs do not serve an indicated purpose in my projects; practical indicator lights fit better than decorative flashing effects.",
    "My small relay module does not imply that I need to switch high-voltage AC equipment, and nothing in my history suggests I have a milling machine for the cutters."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Having bought electronics components seems to have been taken as interest in almost any electronics part, even when its function differs from what I have used.",
    "My relay and thermometer purchases seem to have been treated as reasons to buy more specialized versions without evidence that I need their added capabilities."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I choose supplies when they solve a concrete project need; related items can interest me without being something I would buy now.",
    "Existing supplies and overlapping functions matter: my earlier kit included LEDs, one component tester is enough for now, and the broader lead kit covers my immediate connection needs.",
    "A contact thermometer would become useful if I needed probe measurements or two-point comparisons, but my infrared thermometer already covers my current interest."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my practical electronics interests but sometimes mistake a related function for a current project need."
}
